method: Horizontal dark-ink density (greyscale <120), autocorrelation across selected narrow text regions; strongest lag between 12 and 23 pixels at the 1880-pixel display scale. Original image is read without alteration. Convert using estimated visible page height / assumed 240 mm.
limitations: Photograph has perspective, curved pages and uncertain exact trim. Values are approximate baseline/line-spacing estimates, not recovered font sizes. Exact font size requires the typeface and a calibrated flat scan or physical measurement. Use ranges 8.5–9.5 pt for compact practical leading and 10–11 pt for introductory leading; do not design to decimal precision.
designApplication: Use compact headings and spacing, avoid unused panel padding, place text beside artwork. Main pilot advice stays 9 pt with approximately 11.2–11.7 pt leading; retain distinct instructions and source images.
